mapper.select:
select n.ID, n.TITLE, n.CONTENT, n.CREATE_DATE, u.Loginname as loginName from notice_inf n join user_inf u on u.ID = n.USER_ID
and n.ID=#{id}
and n.TITLE LIKE concat('%', #{title}, '%')
and n.CONTENT LIKE concat('%', #{content}, '%')
and n.CREATE_DATE like concat(#{createDate}, '%')
and u.Loginname like concat('%', #{loginName}, '%')
order by n.CREATE_DATE desc
mapper.update: update notice_inf set TITLE=#{noticeInf.title}, CONTENT=#{noticeInf.content}, CREATE_DATE=#{noticeInf.createDate}, USER_ID=(select u.ID from user_inf u where u.Loginname=#{Loginname}) where ID=#{noticeInf.id}
mapper.insert: insert into notice_inf (id, title, content, create_date, user_id) VALUE (null, #{noticeInf.title}, #{noticeInf.content}, #{noticeInf.createDate}, (select ID from user_inf where Loginname=#{Loginname}))
mapper.select: select * from notice_inf ni where ni.ID in (select wn.n_id from wait_notice wn where wn.n_id not in (select pn.notice_id from pushed_notice pn where pn.user_name=#{username}) and (scope=#{status} or scope=3 or scope=5))
